en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Knowledge of basic terms related to buildings and constructions systems, basic types of wooden buildings, design principes, knowledge of the drawings.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Basic terms in building industries, materials for wood- construction. (allowance 2/2)2.Normative and legislation standards for wood construction. (allowance 2/2)3.Design aspects for construction from wood a nd from materials on wood base. (allowance 2/2)4.Founding of wood- constructions. (allowance 2/2)5.Single parts of constructions - vertical supporting frame, external cladding. (allowance 2/2)6.Horizontal supporting constructions, wooden roof construction. (allowance 2/2)7.Desgn thesis for stir. standard and regulations for wooden starcases. (allowance 2/2)8.Wood constructions model, evolution, partion current wood constructions in agreement with bearing system. (allowance 2/2)9.Frame - wood construction- requirements, proposal theses, frame. (allowance 2/2)10.Skeletal construction, requirements, theses, horizontal bracing, cladding. (allowance 2/2)11.Massive construction form wood, timber building, modern massive wood-construction. (allowance 2/2)12.Design aspects for cladding, termal protector aspects. (allowance 2/2)13.Systems design of wood- construction, construction details, cladding thicknesses. (allowance 2/2)14.Roof constructions, design, type of roof, roof cladding. (allowance 2/2)
